timeline.summary: Kapil Garg (MD of Hindon Mercantile) confirms no encumbrance on Mufin Green Finance shares during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Kapil Garg, on behalf of Mufin Green Finance Limited promoters, declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
Mufin Green Finance released its Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹154 Cr utilized from preferential issue proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹64.67 Cr (+30.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹11.09 Cr (+208.1% YoY).

Mufin Green Finance Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings conference call on FY26 Q4 results, held May 28, 2026, signed by **Mayank Pratap Singh** (Director) and **DigitallyMAYANK** (via e-signature).
Mufin Green Finance Management Committee approved issuance of listed secured NCDs on a private placement basis for up to ₹119 Cr.
Mufin Green Finance guided for FY27 AUM of ₹2,500 Cr and PAT of ₹80-90 Cr on its Q4FY26 earnings call.
